verdict.rationale: Formant explicitly supports dispatching help when 'something looks wrong', automating incident response workflows, teleoperating devices to take control, and keeping intervention records with human approval gates — collectively implying a failure-to-human-intervention flow. However, there's no explicit documentation of a formal 'intervention queue' construct, ticket/queue management, or an explicit handback-to-autonomy mechanic. Missing for 10: documented intervention queue UI/workflow, explicit hand-back-to-autonomy step, and independent/hands-on evidence of this end-to-end flow.
